nodes.label: ADR 0162: With GLUE Home running, the page is only its screen
nodes.rationale: When GLUE Home runs, the browser page becomes only its screen and starts none of the library's work: no sync, analysis, backups, repairs, or DJ library finding and following. Work moved to GLUE Home's engine.

nodes.label: ADR 0165: GLUE Home makes the duplicate groups
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home creates duplicate groups and points playlists at the best copies in Rust, held byte-for-byte to the website's implementation.

nodes.label: ADR 0164: GLUE Home matches the duplicates
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home matches duplicates' fingerprints in Rust, held byte-for-byte to the website's implementation, while the page asks it and shows its groups.

nodes.label: ADR 0160: GLUE Home's service in its engine
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home's service (status, timers, Start/Stop, backups, reminders, updates, native check) is in its Rust engine with no hidden page.

nodes.label: ADR 0153: The library engine in Rust
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home's library engine in Rust (crates/glue-engine), tested end-to-end against the real one, handles all library operations through /rpc.

nodes.label: ADR 0147: GLUE Home analyses natively
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home analyses songs natively in Rust (crates/glue-audio), held to the website's results by golden tests.
